info.title: SeanBlog Frame Backend API
info.description: SeanBlog Frame backend API for a single-administrator personal blog CMS. Public endpoints require no authentication. All /api/admin/* endpoints require a valid Auth.js administrator session cookie. Response DTOs are scenario-oriented: list/search endpoints return compact summaries, detail/editor endpoints return the fields needed by that page, and public endpoints omit private moderation/request metadata.

ArticleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an article. Only PUBLISHED articles with a non-null publishedAt are visible through public article endpoints.

CommentStatus.description: Moderation status of a guest comment. Only APPROVED comments are visible in public article detail responses.

code.description: Stable application error code. Use this for client-side branching instead of parsing message text.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for debugging or simple UI display.

issues.description: Validation issue details from Zod. Present on VALIDATION_ERROR responses.

error.description: Machine-readable error wrapper used by application-owned API endpoints.

total.description: Total number of records matching the filter before pagination.

page.description: Current one-based page number after defaults are applied.

pageSize.description: Number of records requested per page after defaults are applied. Maximum is 100.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages for the current pageSize. Can be 0 when total is 0.

name.description: Unique display name for the category.

slug.description: Unique URL-safe slug used in routes and category filters.

sortOrder.description: Manual ordering value. Lower values appear first.

articles.description: Number of all articles related to this category, including draft, published, and archived articles.

Category.description: Category record used by public taxonomy endpoints and admin taxonomy management. Public/admin category lists are sorted by sortOrder ascending, then name ascending.

name.description: Unique display name for the tag.

slug.description: Unique URL-safe slug used in routes and tag filters.

articles.description: Number of all articles related to this tag, including draft, published, and archived articles.

_count.description: Relation counts returned by Prisma. _count.articles counts all related articles, including draft and archived articles.

Tag.description: Tag record used by public taxonomy endpoints and admin taxonomy management. Tag lists are sorted by name ascending.

url.description: Public or application URL where the media can be accessed.

key.description: Unique storage key/reference for the media object. The backend enforces uniqueness.

mimeType.description: MIME content type, such as image/webp.

width.description: Optional image width in pixels. Null/omitted for non-image files or unknown dimensions.

height.description: Optional image height in pixels. Null/omitted for non-image files or unknown dimensions.

Media.description: Media metadata record. This API stores metadata only; it does not upload, transform, or delete binary files/blobs.

key.description: Unique setting key. The backend accepts arbitrary keys.

value.description: Deserialized setting value. Non-string values are JSON-stringified on write. String values that look like JSON literals can deserialize as non-strings on read.

SiteSetting.description: Arbitrary site setting key/value record. Values are stored as strings and deserialized with JSON.parse when possible on read.

title.description: Required article title. Also used to generate slug on create when slug is omitted.

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only. Generated from title on create when omitted.

excerpt.description: Optional summary. Empty string is normalized to null. Generated from contentMarkdown on create/update when contentMarkdown is provided and excerpt is omitted.

contentMarkdown.description: Required Markdown source used for editing and server-side HTML generation.

contentHtml.description: Optional pre-rendered HTML. Empty string is normalized to null. When omitted/null and contentMarkdown is supplied, the server generates HTML.

coverImage.description: Optional cover image URL/path. Empty string is normalized to null.

status.description: Article status. Defaults to DRAFT on create.

metaTitle.description: Optional SEO title. Empty string is normalized to null.

metaDescription.description: Optional SEO description. Empty string is normalized to null.

metaKeywords.description: Optional SEO keywords string. Empty string is normalized to null.

isPinned.description: Whether the article should be prioritized in public lists. Defaults to false on create.

categoryId.description: Optional category ID. Empty string is normalized to null.

tagIds.description: Tag IDs to attach to the article. Defaults to an empty list on create.

publishedAt.description: Optional publish timestamp. Used when status is PUBLISHED, or when status is omitted and the caller explicitly updates publishedAt.

changeNote.description: Optional revision note. Empty string is normalized to null.

ArticleInput.description: Create article request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. If slug is omitted, it is generated from title. If contentHtml is omitted/null, it is generated from contentMarkdown. If excerpt is omitted, it is generated from contentMarkdown. Creating a PUBLISHED article sets publishedAt to the provided value or current server time; non-published status clears publishedAt unless explicitly provided. tagIds syncs article tags and an initial revision is created.

ArticleUpdateInput.description: Patch article request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Updating title does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided. If contentMarkdown is provided and contentHtml is omitted/null, contentHtml is regenerated. If tagIds is omitted, tags are unchanged; if tagIds is [], all tags are removed. Each successful update creates a revision.

title.description: Optional new title. Does not change slug unless slug is also provided.

slug.description: Optional new URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

excerpt.description: Optional summary override. Empty string is normalized to null. If contentMarkdown is provided and excerpt is omitted, excerpt is regenerated.

contentMarkdown.description: Optional Markdown source update. When supplied, contentHtml is regenerated unless contentHtml is also supplied.

contentHtml.description: Optional pre-rendered HTML override. Empty string is normalized to null.

coverImage.description: Optional cover image URL/path. Empty string is normalized to null.

status.description: Optional status update. PUBLISHED sets publishedAt to provided value or current server time; non-published clears publishedAt unless provided.

metaTitle.description: Optional SEO title. Empty string is normalized to null.

metaDescription.description: Optional SEO description. Empty string is normalized to null.

metaKeywords.description: Optional SEO keywords string. Empty string is normalized to null.

categoryId.description: Optional category ID update. Empty string is normalized to null.

tagIds.description: Optional complete replacement of article tags. Omitted leaves tags unchanged; [] clears all tags.

changeNote.description: Optional revision note. Empty string is normalized to null.

name.description: Required unique category display name. Used to generate slug on create when slug is omitted.

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

description.description: Optional category description. Empty string is normalized to null.

sortOrder.description: Optional manual ordering value. Defaults to 0 on create.

CategoryInput.description: Create category request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. If slug is omitted, it is generated from name. sortOrder defaults to 0.

name.description: Required unique tag display name. Used to generate slug on create when slug is omitted.

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

TagInput.description: Create tag request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. If slug is omitted, it is generated from name.

articleId.description: Target article ID. The article only needs to exist; it does not need to be public/published.

content.description: Comment body. Trimmed and required after trimming. Maximum 5000 characters.

guestName.description: Optional guest display name. Empty string is normalized to null.

guestEmail.description: Optional guest email. Must be a valid email when supplied; empty string is invalid, not normalized to null.

parentId.description: Optional parent comment ID for replies. Empty string is normalized to null. Must belong to the same article.

CommentInput.description: Guest comment submission body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. Comments can be created for any existing article ID. parentId, when provided, must reference a comment on the same article. The server records IP and user agent for moderation but never returns them from public responses.

isSpam.description: Optional explicit spam flag. If omitted, SPAM sets true and all other statuses set false.

CommentModerationInput.description: Admin comment moderation body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. If isSpam is omitted, it is derived from status: true only for SPAM, false for all other statuses.

url.description: Public/application URL for the media file. The backend validates only that this is a non-empty string.

key.description: Unique storage key/reference. The backend validates uniqueness but does not verify the object exists in storage.

size.description: File size in bytes. Must be >= 0.

mimeType.description: MIME content type, such as image/webp.

width.description: Optional image width in pixels. Must be positive when supplied.

height.description: Optional image height in pixels. Must be positive when supplied.

MediaInput.description: Create media metadata request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. This creates a database metadata record only; it does not upload binary data.

value.description: Setting value. Non-string values are JSON-stringified on write. String values are stored raw and may deserialize as non-strings if they look like JSON literals.

SettingInput.description: Create/update site setting request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. The value can be a string, number, boolean, object, or array.

CategoryUpdateInput.description: Patch category request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Updating name does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided.

name.description: Optional new category display name. Does not change slug unless slug is also provided.

slug.description: Optional new URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

description.description: Optional category description. Empty string is normalized to null.

sortOrder.description: Optional manual ordering value. Omitted leaves the current sortOrder unchanged.

TagUpdateInput.description: Patch tag request body. Unknown JSON properties are rejected. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Updating name does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided.

name.description: Optional new tag display name. Does not change slug unless slug is also provided.

slug.description: Optional new URL slug. Must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.

TagSummary.description: Compact tag object embedded in article DTOs.

PublicArticleSummary.description: Slim article card for public listing/search pages. Does not include article body or admin-only fields.

id.description: Stable article identifier. Use this for admin/editor APIs when available.

publishedAt.description: Public publish timestamp. Public lists only include records where this is non-null.

category.description: Compact category object, or null when uncategorized.

tags.description: Compact tag objects attached to the article.

example.title: Hello SeanBlog Frame
example.excerpt: Initial seeded article for the blog CMS.

PublicComment.description: Public-safe approved comment payload. Email, IP address, user agent, spam flags, and moderation status are intentionally omitted.

guestName.description: Guest display name, or null when omitted.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID for replies. Top-level public comments have null.

PublicCommentReceipt.description: Minimal receipt returned after a guest submits a comment.

status.description: Initial moderation status. New public comments default to PENDING.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID for replies, or null.

contentHtml.description: Rendered HTML body for public display. Markdown source is intentionally omitted from public responses.

viewCount.description: Stored view count. This endpoint currently reads the value but does not increment it.

category.description: Compact category object, or null when uncategorized.

tags.description: Compact tag objects attached to the article.

comments.description: Approved top-level comments with approved replies only. Ordered oldest first.

AdminArticleSummary.description: Slim article row for admin list pages. Does not include article body or revision bodies.

isPinned.description: Whether this article is prioritized in public lists.

publishedAt.description: Publish timestamp, or null for non-published articles.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Admin article lists are sorted by this field descending.

category.description: Compact category object, or null when uncategorized.

ArticleRevisionSummary.description: Revision metadata for admin article detail. Body snapshots are intentionally omitted from the default detail response.

title.description: Article title captured for this revision.

changeNote.description: Optional change note for this revision.

AdminArticleDetail.description: Full editable article payload for admin create/update/detail pages. Revision bodies are not included by default.

slug.description: Article slug used by public article routes when published.

contentHtml.description: Rendered HTML body used for public display.

isPinned.description: Whether this article is prioritized in public lists.

publishedAt.description: Publish timestamp, or null for non-published articles.

categoryId.description: Attached category ID, or null when uncategorized.

category.description: Compact category object, or null when uncategorized.

tags.description: Compact tag objects attached to the article.

revisions.description: Revision metadata only. Historical Markdown/HTML bodies are intentionally omitted from the default detail response.

AdminComment.description: Comment payload for moderation UI. Technical request metadata such as IP address and user agent are omitted from default responses.

guestName.description: Guest display name, or null when omitted.

guestEmail.description: Guest email, or null when omitted.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID for replies, or null.

title.description: Article title shown in moderation context.

slug.description: Article slug for linking from moderation UI.

article.description: Compact article object included in admin comment list responses. Patch/delete responses omit this property.

Unauthorized.description: Administrator session is missing or invalid.

get.description: Returns the Auth.js provider registry. This backend currently exposes only the Credentials provider for username=admin.

200.description: Provider registry response managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Auth.js managed error endpoint/page for authentication failures. Exact response shape is managed by Auth.js.

200.description: Auth.js error page or response. Content type is managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Returns the current session when a valid Auth.js session cookie is present; unauthenticated requests return Auth.js empty/null session semantics.

200.description: Current session object or an empty/null session response managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Returns a CSRF token used by Auth.js form POST requests.

200.description: CSRF token response managed by Auth.js.

Auth.js Credentials Provider callback. Submit username=admin and password using Auth.js form semantics. Invalid credentials generally follow Auth.js callback/redirect behavior rather than this application error format.

200.description: Credentials callback response managed by Auth.js.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check. Returns exactly { status: "ok" }.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag slug filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

get.description: Returns PUBLISHED articles with non-null publishedAt only. Results are sorted by isPinned descending, then publishedAt descending. category and tag filters are slugs; unknown slugs return an empty list, not 404. List items intentionally omit article body and admin-only fields.

get.summary: Get published article detail by slug

200.description: Published article detail with rendered HTML body and public-safe comments.

get.description: Returns one public article detail by slug. Returns 404 unless the article is PUBLISHED and has a non-null publishedAt. Includes rendered HTML and approved public-safe comments only. Does not increment viewCount.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Required search keyword. Empty value is invalid and returns 400.

get.description: Searches PUBLISHED articles with non-null publishedAt. The keyword is matched case-insensitively against title, excerpt, and contentMarkdown. Results are sorted by publishedAt descending and return the same summary DTO as public article lists.
Returns all categories sorted by sortOrder ascending, then name ascending. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.
Returns one category by slug. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.
Returns all tags sorted by name ascending. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.
Returns one tag by slug. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.

201.description: Created comment, pending moderation by default.

post.description: Creates a guest comment for any existing article ID. New comments default to PENDING moderation. parentId must belong to the same article. The server records IP from x-forwarded-for first, then x-real-ip, and records user-agent; these values are not returned in public responses.

get.description: Returns RSS 2.0 XML for the latest 50 PUBLISHED articles with non-null publishedAt. Item fields are title, link, guid, description, and pubDate. XML values are escaped. Channel title/description/link come from siteName, siteDescription, and siteUrl settings with environment/default fallbacks.

Returns XML sitemap entries for the homepage, all PUBLISHED articles with non-null publishedAt, all categories, and all tags. Article priority is 0.8 weekly; category/tag priority is 0.5 weekly; homepage priority is 1 daily. Base URL comes from siteUrl setting or NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL/default fallback.
Returns robots.txt allowing /, disallowing /admin/, and pointing to /sitemap.xml. Base URL comes from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL or localhost fallback, not the database siteUrl setting.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Article status filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag slug filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning paginated admin article summaries sorted by updatedAt descending. Filters: status enum, category slug, tag slug, q keyword. q matches title, excerpt, and contentMarkdown case-insensitively. Empty query values are treated as omitted.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint that creates an article and returns the full editable admin detail. Server-derived fields: slug from title if omitted, contentHtml from contentMarkdown if omitted/null, excerpt from contentMarkdown if omitted, publishedAt set when status=PUBLISHED, tags synced from tagIds, and an initial revision is created.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning full editable article detail by ID. Revisions are returned as metadata only and sorted by version descending.

patch.description: Authenticated endpoint for partial article updates. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Updating title does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided. Omitted tagIds leaves tags unchanged; [] clears all tags. Every successful update creates a revision.

delete.description: Authenticated endpoint that hard-deletes the article. Related article-tag joins, comments, and revisions are removed by cascading relations.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint that sets status=PUBLISHED, sets publishedAt to the current server time, writes changeNote="Published article", creates a revision, and returns admin article detail.
Authenticated endpoint that sets status=ARCHIVED, clears publishedAt, writes changeNote="Archived article", creates a revision, and returns admin article detail.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning all categories sorted by sortOrder ascending, then name ascending. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint that creates a category. If slug is omitted, it is generated from name. sortOrder defaults to 0. name and slug are unique.

patch.description: Authenticated endpoint for partial category updates. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Updating name does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided.

delete.description: Authenticated endpoint that deletes the category record. Articles in the category are not deleted; their categoryId is set to null by the database relation.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning all tags sorted by name ascending. _count.articles counts all related articles, including drafts and archived articles.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint that creates a tag. If slug is omitted, it is generated from name. name and slug are unique.

patch.description: Authenticated endpoint for partial tag updates. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Updating name does not change slug unless slug is explicitly provided.

delete.description: Authenticated endpoint that deletes the tag record and article-tag join rows. Articles themselves are not deleted.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comment status filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

parameters.name: articleId
parameters.description: Article ID filter. Empty query value is treated as omitted.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning paginated comments sorted by createdAt descending. Filters: status enum and articleId. List items include compact article { id, title, slug } and do not include nested replies, IP, or userAgent. Empty query values are treated as omitted.

patch.description: Authenticated endpoint that updates comment status and spam flag. If isSpam is omitted, it is derived from status: true only for SPAM, otherwise false.

delete.description: Authenticated soft-delete endpoint. Sets status=TRASHED and, because isSpam is omitted, sets isSpam=false. Returns the updated admin comment DTO.

media.description: Media metadata resource(s) for this operation.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning all media metadata records sorted by createdAt descending. This list is currently not paginated.

media.description: Media metadata resource(s) for this operation.

post.description: Authenticated endpoint that creates a metadata record only. It does not upload binary data. key must be unique. url and key are plain strings and are not verified against storage.

delete.description: Authenticated endpoint that deletes only the database media metadata record. It does not delete the underlying file/blob from storage.

settings.description: All site settings sorted by key ascending.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning all site settings sorted by key ascending. Values are deserialized using JSON.parse when possible.

setting.description: Site setting resource, or null for missing keys on GET.

get.description: Authenticated endpoint returning one setting by arbitrary key. Missing keys return { setting: null } with HTTP 200, not 404.

setting.description: Site setting resource, or null for missing keys on GET.

put.description: Authenticated endpoint that upserts an arbitrary setting key. Non-string values are JSON-stringified on write. String values are stored raw and may deserialize as non-strings if they look like JSON literals.
